N1.s: Du nutzt alle %lld kostenlosen Cutlings. Schalte Cutling in der App frei, dann ist das neue gespeichert.
N1.back: You use all 5 free Cutlings. Switch Cutling in the app free, then is the new-one saved.
N1.why: Opens with the S3 frame so the limit always sounds the same; 'in der App' carries the continue-in-app step; 'das neue' points back to 'Cutlings' and avoids a second 'Cutling' right after the app's name.

N2.s: Du nutzt alle %lld kostenlosen Cutlings. Für mehr Platz schalte Cutling in der App frei.
N2.back: You use all 5 free Cutlings. For more room switch Cutling in the app free.
N2.why: Same opening as N1; 'Für mehr Platz' picks up S2's 'Platz für mehr', and putting the goal before the imperative is ordinary spoken German, as in 'Für mehr Infos tippe hier'.

N3.why: The status word first, then the dot, as in K1; 'Platz frei' means vacant, as on a car park sign, so it does not clash with 'kostenlos'; 'ein' spelled out reads warmer than a digit; 28 characters.

N4.why: '%lld von %lld' and 'belegt' are M4's pair and S22's word, so the full state looks the same everywhere; no alarm word, it just reports; 28 characters.

N5.why: The pair was just shown with 'belegt' in N4, so here it stands alone to make room; 'Zum Speichern freischalten' says that unlocking saves this item and reads as a tap target; 36 characters.

N6.why: S15's button word, so the action keeps one name; it is 12 characters, 2 over the budget, and no shorter word means this: 'Entsperren' is unlocking the phone's screen and 'Kaufen' would promise a purchase the button does not make.

N7.s: Du nutzt alle %lld kostenlosen Cutlings. Schalte Cutling frei, dann ist das neue gespeichert.
N7.back: You use all 5 free Cutlings. Switch Cutling free, then is the new-one saved.
N7.why: N1's sentence without 'in der App', because the green button beside it opens the app; same words for the same promise; 90 characters.

N8.s: Für dich zurückgelegt. Schalte Cutling in der App frei, dann ist es gespeichert.
N8.back: For you put-back. Switch Cutling in the app free, then is it saved.
N8.why: 'Für dich zurückgelegt' is what a German shop says when it holds an item for you, so 'kept' sounds warm, not technical; it avoids 'aufgehoben', which also means cancelled; the second sentence is N1's.
